description: Returns liveness and the settlement network the API is running on. Use it to confirm a buyer wallet, facilitator key, and x402 client all work before paying for data. Paid route: USDC 0.01 per request, settled over x402 on Celo. Without a payment the call returns the x402 payment requirements instead of data, and the requirements carry the exact amount for the call that was asked for.
name: x402_ping
title: Payment connectivity check
